query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

content.text:
Good places to find **latest stock market news**:

- **Reuters Markets** — fast, factual breaking market and company news.
- **Bloomberg** — excellent for real-time markets, macro, bonds, currencies, and global finance; some content is paywalled.
- **CNBC Markets** — good for live market coverage, TV clips, premarket/after-hours updates, and trader commentary. ([cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Wall Street Journal Markets** — strong reporting on companies, markets, the Fed, and economic policy; mostly subscription-based.
- **MarketWatch** — accessible market headlines, personal finance, stock updates, and investor-focused analysis. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MarketWatch?utm_source=openai))
- **Yahoo Finance** — free quotes, watchlists, charts, earnings calendars, and aggregated news from sources like Reuters and Bloomberg. ([finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Investing.com** — free global market data, calendars, futures, commodities, forex, and stock news. ([investing.com](https://www.investing.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **StockAnalysis.com/news** — useful aggregator showing recent articles from outlets like CNBC, Reuters, Bloomberg, and MarketWatch. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/news/?utm_source=openai))

For a simple setup: use **Yahoo Finance** or **CNBC** for free daily tracking, **Reuters/Bloomberg** for higher-quality breaking news, and **WSJ/MarketWatch** for deeper market context.
